notes_for_editor: Thin record: one primary list (Starr, 1950 build, LS-40 80 ft, seasonal operation, removed), a 1950 program note from Starr's pictorial history, and two lists (CNY Hiking, FFLA) that mark it gone. No source read gives a removal year, what remains at the site, land ownership or public access, so the story says none of these. A FFLA NY Facebook post asks whether the remains are on private property; only its title was readable, so it is not used. Search results mention other posts about the tower; they were not readable and are not used. Name spelling differs: Prattsburg Mtn (Starr, FFLA) vs Prattsburgh (CNY Hiking); the story uses the record's spelling. The Starr list elevation (2,163 ft) is not used. Operating months are undated, so staffing is marked undated.
